fig1_inclusion_exclusion.svg: Inclusion-exclusion on a 52-card deck with A = heart and B = face card. The overlap P(A and B) is subtracted once so it is not double counted, giving P(A or B) = 0.250 + 0.231 - 0.058 = 0.423, matching the brute-force count.
fig2_dice_sum_pmf.svg: The probability law of the sum of two fair dice, built from the 36-outcome equally-likely sample space via P(A) = |A|/|S|. The masses form a triangle peaking at 7 (6/36) and obey Axiom A2: they sum to exactly 1.
